summary: Build the isolated Compose lab foundation
description: Build the pinned Compose topology, controller/runner image, image lock, readiness matrix, security matrix, host wrapper, and network-isolation contract without starting unseeded real services.
acceptance: Rendered MVP Compose publishes zero host ports and attaches every application service only to an internal bridge with isolated gateway mode.
Every image reference and Dockerfile base is platform-specific and pinned by immutable digest with provenance metadata.
No service is privileged or mounts the Docker socket; controller and runner are non-root, capability-free, no-new-privileges, and read-only-root with explicit writable mounts only.
Build contexts exclude Git, workflow state, plans, credentials, runtime state, evidence, caches, media, and downloads.
Only the controller isolation probe starts; real Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent, and Jellyfin processes remain stopped until lab-04.
Negative probes prove no host/API exposure, LAN/internet reachability, or Docker authority.
